question: In a renal clear cell study utilizing bulk rna seq, An investigator inputs TPM (Transcripts Per Million) abundance matrices directly into DESeq2 `DESeqDataSetFromMatrix()` function. How should this analysis be evaluated and executed?
proposed_analysis: Proposed analysis: An investigator inputs TPM (Transcripts Per Million) abundance matrices directly into DESeq2 `DESeqDataSetFromMatrix()` function.
preferred_analysis: DESeq2 requires raw un-normalized integer counts because its parametric dispersion estimation relies directly on the Poisson-Negative Binomial sampling noise model. Passing library-normalized TPMs violates dispersion model assumptions.
reasoning_summary: Rigorous scientific assessment for renal_clear_cell: DESeq2 requires raw un-normalized integer counts because its parametric dispersion estimation relies directly on the Poisson-Negative Binomial sampling noise model. Passing library-normalized TPMs violates dispersion model assumptions.

supported_claims.statement: Experimental data for renal_clear_cell was generated under specified assay parameters.

unsupported_claims.statement: The flawed analysis proves generalizable mechanism in renal_clear_cell.

limitations: Methodological validity requires rigorous control of tpm_count_matrix_misuse.
